precedence: Keep both raw values. Use valid current JSON; if current is malformed and legacy is valid, mark legacy as a recovery candidate. Never discard malformed raw text.

bookmarks.rule: Map legacy term IDs; deduplicate by representative ID; preserve unresolved IDs.

recent_views.rule: Map IDs; preserve order and 15-item cap; preserve unresolved IDs.

quiz_wrongs.rule: Map IDs; review-needed wins over learned; keep source history.

learned_cards.rule: Map IDs; review-needed wins over learned; keep source history.

recent_searches.rule: Keep raw free text and offer deletion.

checklist_1.rule: Map month and original index to taskId; academicYear=null.

checklist_2.rule: Map month and original index to taskId; academicYear=null.

checklist_3.rule: Map month and original index to taskId; academicYear=null.

checklist_4.rule: Map month and original index to taskId; academicYear=null.

checklist_7.rule: Map month and original index to taskId; academicYear=null.

checklist_8.rule: Map month and original index to taskId; academicYear=null.

checklist_9.rule: Map month and original index to taskId; academicYear=null.

checklist_10.rule: Map month and original index to taskId; academicYear=null.

checklist_11.rule: Map month and original index to taskId; academicYear=null.

checklist_12.rule: Map month and original index to taskId; academicYear=null.

ics_year.rule: Selection only; never infer the academic year of checklist values.

year_task_dates.rule: Map academicYear_month_index to taskId; preserve legacy ICS UID.

board_title.rule: Create a project only when the key actually exists; do not migrate display defaults.

board_tasks.rule: Preserve title, done, IDs and an explicitly saved empty object.

settings.rule: Preserve school, teacher and class text without guessing missing values.

class_names.rule: Preserve names; do not merge identical names.

record_drafts.rule: Keep area text without assigning a student.

counsel_records.rule: Preserve names, details and follow-up; student matching requires confirmation.

counsel_schedule_opts.rule: Preserve user-entered names and scheduling options.

theme_mode.rule: Only light, dark or system; available while locked.

situation_runs.rule: Added after the R0a baseline. Per situation publicId: startedAt and per-step check times (ISO strings) only, no free text. Preserve as-is.

start_courses.rule: Added after the R0a baseline. Active course id and per-course done flags keyed by item reference. No free text.
